select r.id, r.outbound_code AS outboundCode, r.material_id AS materialId, r.batch_no AS batchNo, r.out_num AS outNum, r.out_user AS outUser, r.out_time AS outTime, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName from tb_out_record r left join tb_material m on r.material_id = m.id
AND r.outbound_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{outboundCode}, '%')
AND r.material_id = #{materialId}
AND r.out_time >= CONCAT(#{startTime}, ' 00:00:00')
AND r.out_time <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
AND ( r.outbound_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.material_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.material_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY r.out_time DESC
